title: NREV-01 and NREV-02 bounded public-report repair proposal
status: proposal only; root final audit after026 pending
scope: Exactly 20 existing decision final fields and their 20 current doubt-reading mirrors. Existing selected TeX, literal source groups, witness and own-reader fields, C/H values, alternatives, local qualifications, hands, counts, approval history and source maps remain unchanged.
scope_authority: Root task: prepare a forward/inverse patch proposal only for the two queued deficiencies; do not apply; final audit after026. Later root clarification preserves the historical map and requests its dependency separately.

scan018-section09.literal:
## 09 — Proof insertions, guides and hook

Viewed `readers/018/B/crop09_insertions.png` once.

L018-13: select complete C G03, containing raised qu'une, cancelled la, classe, two guide runs separated at the l crossing, and one literal la cancellation. A faint break is visible at the crossing; C's two runs retain that interruption. Count the complete guide cluster once, high C1/H1; the already-agreed cancellation adds no count. L018-14 / C018-R08-1: retain U alpha/x, medium C0/H0; its loop and crossing leave both candidates. L018-15: retain the independently inspected circle/zero recurrence, medium C0/H1 qualified; print circ because the lemma is the first qualified occurrence. L018-16/17: select complete C G04, containing donnée, the raised U/de/Pi label, ne, the long guide and its single locally qualified comma-like hook. The hook sits at the guide junction; its punctuation/return role remains unresolved, low confidence for role. No second printed comma is added. L018-16 is the high-confidence main-guide count parent C1/H1; L018-17 is a noncount component, C0/H0, log_decision true, preserving the C punctuation alternative and B's definite guide reading. L018-18: only live ne and the adjoining guide occupy the proposed extra-word locus; no additional struck un is recovered, high C0/H1. C G03/G04 together supply classe donnée once; contient follows outside once. Both complete groups retain every node, path, fixed origin, baseline and qualifier. All wording and corrections are attributed to his hand, while the hook's function is left open. No derived geometry or rendering check was performed.

scan021-section03.literal:
## 03 — First intersection: two complete roofed Sigma groups

Viewed `readers/021/C/crop18_first_intersection.png` once.

Both roofs, two separate short upper runs, bent Sigma bodies and all lower/raised marks are visible. The first index has alpha followed by a distinctly further-lowered 0; no raised plus occurs at that first Sigma. The second has a separate dotted i and a raised plus. Select the complete shapes of C021-G01a and the second Sigma in C021-G01; preserve every run once, with the first printed recurring qualifier for head/retrace versus independent upper-rule role. A and C qualify that role; B draws the runs while calling the glyph reading unchanged. The two local roles remain unresolved, low, one new firm-C qualification per physical Sigma (each C1/H0); later repeated head alternatives remain in the record without repeating the printed wrapper. This records the observed separate runs without assigning an overline operation. No-plus on the first occurrence is a confirmed shared C/H reading (C0/H0, high).

scan021-section04.literal:
## 04 — Second intersection: shared lower curl and short head runs

Viewed `readers/021/C/crop19_second_intersection.png` once.

Select the right pair within C021-G01. The first Sigma lower arm turns directly into the alpha-shaped loop; its small 0 is a distinct lower loop. C's literal integrated alpha keeps that shared stroke once, whereas A/B use a separate font index. The following Sigma has the rounded bent body, a short descending-sloped head run, and the small i mark at its right. Preserve the two complete literal groups, retaining the respective local head/retrace-versus-independent-rule doubts, low, each C1/H0 as a new firm-C qualification (the recurring printed wrapper stays only on the first occurrence in section03). Ordinary alpha0/i identity, absence of roofs in this pair and equality to empty remain unchanged. C021-G01 is now selected as the whole first-display parent, including i.e resolved in section02 and both preceding roofed groups in section03; no duplicated index glyph is to be added.

scan021-section07.literal:
## 07 — Roofed Sigma in the upper U display

Viewed `readers/021/C/crop20_first_union_sigma.png` once.

The upper U display reads U=X setminus union_{alpha in K} roofed Sigma_alpha^+, with the large round union, low alpha-in-K limit, right-shifted roof, short upper run, angled body, low alpha and raised plus. Select A021G05's complete Sigma group within C021-G02, preserving its local shape and all companions; C's ordinary roofed-Sigma macro leaves that same local run implicit. The upper-run role remains head/retrace | independent upper rule, low, C1/H0; this is a later recurring local doubt and needs no repeated printed wrapper. The formula reading and union limit are shared by all three and by the witnesses. No extra sign or bar is assigned from the formula's expected role.

scan021-section11.literal:
## 11 — Central union, Sigma and small upper trace

Viewed `readers/021/C/crop06_central_union.png` once.

Actual C021-R14 resolves to the round union with a definite high transverse run through its left stalk, high, C1/H1. The run extends left of that stalk and ends inside the cup; its presence is settled and no mathematical operation is assigned to it. Select complete C021-G03 for E_i subset U_{J,i}=X setminus this union, its alpha-in-K0 limit, and the complete roofed Sigma_alpha^+. The Sigma's lower arm turns into the alpha loop, so retain C's integrated path once. Its short separate upper-run role remains head/retrace | independent rule, low, C1/H0, with no repeated printed wrapper. A small detached dark point and paler downward continuation occur below-left of the roof. Preserve C021-M03's point with A021G07's additional pale lower path, as one qualified point/trace cluster; B/C draw the point alone, A includes the lower trace. C1/H1, low for that complete cluster; hand, role, attachment to roof and surface origin remain undetermined. No additional alpha, point or union crossing is to be duplicated by the merged source.

scan021-section12.literal:
## 12 — Second inclusion and final lowered index

Viewed `readers/021/C/crop07_second_inclusion.png` once.

Select complete C021-G04 for the second inclusion/equality, replacing its right font alpha0|alpha index with B021-G05's complete qualified literal index group. The left Sigma has roof, separate short head, bent body, raised plus and distinct alpha0. The right has its short upper run, bent body and long high minus; its alpha returns into a dark low terminal curl whose separation as a 0 is unresolved. Actual C021-R15 retained alpha0|alpha, medium, C0/H0 (H's primary alpha0 unchanged). Preserve the literal index once, with the original full C row identity. Both Sigma upper-run roles remain locally head/retrace | independent upper rule, low, each C1/H0 as new firm-C qualifications; no repeated printed role wrapper. The source slip table's alpha-only wording remains provenance and is not a second actual doubt row. The cropped line above begins within implique, so this crop does not decide the still-uninspected cela versus ce qui wording.

scan021-section14.literal:
## 14 — Complete marginal diagram, both braces and all six Sigma labels

Viewed `readers/021/A/c09_margin_diagram.png` once.

Select A021DG as the complete anchored tikz-cd parent, with both literal looped braces, five upright rows, the two sideways signed Sigma labels and all visible endpoints. The top upright row is Sigma_i^+ ou Sigma_i^-; the next rows E_i, qualified Sigma_{i alpha}, E_alpha, Sigma_{alpha0}^+. The sideways labels have the complete shared terminal hook/dot i forms, with minus and plus respectively, and must remain literal as A draws them. For the third upright row replace A021D03's glyph source with B021-G06's complete nested third-label group (shared lower-arm hook and dot once), retaining the complete candidate set Sigma_{i alpha} | Sigma_{i,alpha} | Sigma_{dot alpha}; actual C021-R08 retained, medium, C0/H0 component under the H parent. No independent extra i body or comma is supplied. Actual C021-R07 resolves to a literal upright shaft-and-point ! shape, medium, C1/H0 component: in this rotated crop it is one detached point followed by one bent short run; no pair of ou loops is present. Remove the unsure wrapper around A021D05 but keep its literal point/run, and do not assign the sign a mathematical function. The four upright Sigma upper-run roles (top pair, third row, bottom row) remain head/retrace | independent upper rule, low, each C1/H0; later recurring role wrappers are not printed again. The small pale detached run beyond the outer brace is visible: retain qualified A021M04, C1/H0, low, role/hand/surface origin undetermined. The complete brace/placement restoration is one C1/H1 medium parent; the single H diagram-note replacement includes its omitted components, so every diagram component has zero additional H count. The separately inspected lead-in from section13 is outside this parent. B/C's ordinary font sideways Sigmas and B's ordinary upright top/bottom font spans remain quoted alternatives in the source record.

scan021-section16.literal:
## 16 — Exclusion formula and short interrupted right head

Viewed `readers/021/A/c11_exclusion.png` once.

Select A's complete exclusion sequence A021G10 + A021G11 + A021G12 in place of C021-G06. The left group has Sigma_alpha0 with a clear raised plus; the inclusion curve is crossed by one long nearly vertical slant; the right Sigma has its bent body, short dark upper run, pale interrupted extension and small pale point to the left, plus dotted i and raised plus. A021G12 retains those pale pieces that C's continuous head path omits. The two local Sigma head/retrace-versus-independent-rule roles remain qualified in the record, low, each C1/H0; preserve complete glyph clusters without another printed recurring wrapper. The literal crossed-inclusion drawing preserves the shared not-subset reading and its two actual strokes; this alone is C0/H0, a same-reading graphic realization rather than an additional correction count. No extra horizontal equality stroke is supplied.

scan021-section18.literal:
## 18 — Concluding intersection and cqfd.

Viewed `readers/021/C/crop22_proof_conclusion.png` once.

Select complete C021-G08. The first Sigma bottom arm turns down into the i stem and has its detached dot; the second bottom arm turns into the low alpha curl. C keeps those shared components graphically once, whereas A/B use separate font indices. Both raised pluses, the intersection, equality, empty set, following comma and cqfd. with its final point are visible. Retain the two local short-head role doubts, head/retrace | independent upper rule, low, each C1/H0; no repeated printed role wrapper. The formula, comma and abbreviation keep their shared C/H reading and receive no extra correction count. Do not expand cqfd. in the transcription.

scan021-section20.literal:
## 20 — Corollary union retrace and roofed Sigma

Viewed `readers/021/C/crop21_last_union_sigma.png` once.

The corollary display reads V=X setminus union_{alpha in K} roofed Sigma_alpha^+. The round union has a separate pale short left return beside its upper-left stalk; retain C021-G09a with both observed paths (C1/H1, medium for that added literal retrace). A/B use a plain union macro. No added operation is inferred. The Sigma has a right-shifted roof, short upper run, bent body, low alpha and raised plus; replace C's ordinary Sigma macro with complete A021G15. Its local head/retrace-versus-independent-rule role remains open, low, C1/H0, without another printed recurring wrapper. The alpha-in-K limit and absence of additional endpoint punctuation are shared readings. C021-G09 is the selected lower-body framework, with the heading and Pour une classe outside it as in C; later selected replacements must not duplicate those words.

scan021-section22.literal:
## 22 — Complete bottom conditions, overlapping V/E and physical page edge

Viewed `readers/021/C/crop13_bottom_brace.png` once.

The bottom set reads K={alpha in I | bar V cap E_alpha != empty, i.e. deleted V/live E_alpha cap dot V != empty}; retain its actual i.e. spacing with no newly added comma in the TeX. The first V has a separate flat bar and the later V a separate point, both already in C/H. Actual C021-R13 resolves as old V beneath live E_alpha, high, C1/H1: two thin obliques survive under the live E's vertical and horizontal strokes. Keep C021-G09b's complete overlap once, no extra generic strike. Preserve C021-G09's bottom formula and words, but replace its generic opening and closing set braces with B021-G10's full literal looped opening set brace and complete right closing curve; retain the main outer brace through the physical lower page edge without an invented lower return. Use one complete bottom-brace-geometry parent C1/H1, medium for outer plus set-brace paths, zero additional counts on its components. The bottom first Sigma_alpha^+ and final Sigma_alpha in X setminus Sigma_alpha have short upper runs and bent bodies; retain C021-G09's complete literal groups. Their head/retrace-versus-independent-rule doubts remain low, each C1/H0. The final complement's Sigma identity is clear against H's E_alpha: one separate identity row C0/H1, high, with the head-role child adding no further H count. Thus the second condition stays 'Sigma_alpha^+ est l'unique comp. de X setminus Sigma_alpha contenue dans X setminus V', with no final point supplied. The bottom edge cuts the lower continuation of the outer brace and some descenders; no unseen continuations are drawn.
